;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] militants destroy part of [[Palmyra]]'s ancient [[Roman Theatre at Palmyra|Roman theatre]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-38689131 (BBC)]
**An airstrike kills more than 40 [[Al-Nusra Front|Jabhat Fateh al-Sham]] fighters at a jihadist camp west of [[Aleppo]]. It is currently unknown whether American or Russian planes carried out the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-raid-idUSKBN1540RV (Reuters)] [http://www.foxnews.com/world/2017/01/20/more-than-100-core-al-qaeda-fighters-killed-in-u-s-strike-in-syria.html (FOX News)]

;Arts and culture
*The [[Woody Harrelson]] [[biographical film|biopic]] ''[[Lost in London]]'' makes history as the first full-length [[feature film]] to be filmed and [[movie theater|theatrically]] released simultaneously. [https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-38686697 (BBC)] [https://www.theguardian.com/film/2017/jan/20/lost-in-london-review-woody-harrelson-live-movie (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/films/2017/01/20/lost-london-woody-harrelson-breaks-boundaries-supercharged-allen/ (''The Telegraph'')]

;Business and economics
*[[Toilets in Japan]]
**Japanese toilet industries agreed to standardize the iconography of electric toilet seat controls in order to make them less confusing for users. [http://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2017/01/17/national/symbols-toilet-functions-unified-japan/#.WIHGWDUbvcs (''The Japan Times'')] [http://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/p04q0qk0 (BBC)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jan/18/japan-to-end-tourists-toilet-trouble-with-standardised-buttons-olympics (''The Guardian'')] [http://www.sanitary-net.com/news/news1142 (Japan Sanitary Equipment Industry Association)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Search continues for missing firefighters in [[Tehran]]'s [[Plasco Building]] site after the building's deadly fire and collapsing last day. [http://edition.cnn.com/2017/01/20/middleeast/iran-tehran-building-fire-collapse/ (CNN)]
*[[2017 Rigopiano avalanche]]
**[[Italy|Italian]] emergency crews rescue 10 people, including four children, from 16½ feet of snow and wreckage from the luxury Hotel Rigopiano following yesterday's [[Gran Sasso d'Italia|Gran Sasso mountain]] avalanche. Searchers find four bodies, while families of at least 16 people still missing wait for news. [http://www.cbsnews.com/news/avalanche-italy-hotel-five-pulled-put-five-being-saved/ (CBS News)]
*[[2017 Verona bus crash]] 
**A bus carrying [[Hungarian people|Hungarian]] students crashes near [[Verona]] in northern [[Italy]] with at least 18 people dead and 50 injured. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/01/21/least-seven-feared-dead-italian-coach-crash/ (''The Telegraph'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-38703536 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[United Kingdom–United States relations]]
**U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] nominates [[New York Jets]] owner [[Woody Johnson]] to be the next [[United States Ambassador to the United Kingdom]]. [http://news.sky.com/story/new-york-jets-owner-woody-johnson-set-to-be-us-ambassador-to-uk-10735264 (Sky News)]

;Law and crime
*Three people are killed and twenty injured after a man [[January 2017 Melbourne car attack|drove a car]] into the [[Bourke Street, Melbourne|Bourke Street Mall]] in the CBD of the [[Australia]]n city [[Melbourne]]. A man has been arrested and [[Victoria Police]] say the incident is not terror related. In the next few weeks, the death toll would rise to six. [http://www.9news.com.au/National/2017/01/20/13/41/Number-of-pedestrians-injured-in-Melbourne-cbd (Nine Network)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20170202070531/https://au.news.yahoo.com/a/34233875/man-kills-three-injures-20-in-bourke-st/#page1 (AAP via Yahoo! Australia)]
*[[Protests against Donald Trump|Inauguration of Donald Trump protests]]
**Some protesters of the inauguration smash windows, damage cars, and clash with the police. Six police officers and at least one civilian are injured. [[Metropolitan Police Department of the District of Columbia|DC police]] say 217 protesters have been arrested. [http://www.cnn.com/2017/01/19/politics/trump-inauguration-protests-womens-march/ (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[First presidency of Donald Trump|Presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[First inauguration of Donald Trump|Inauguration of Donald Trump]]
***[[Donald Trump]] is officially sworn in as the 45th [[President of the United States]], and [[Mike Pence]] is sworn in as 48th [[Vice President of the United States]].  [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/01/19/donald-trumps-inauguration-countdown-barack-obama-preparing/ (''The Telegraph'')]
**[[First cabinet of Donald Trump|Cabinet of Donald Trump]]
***The [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]] confirms the first two members of [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[Cabinet of the United States|Cabinet]]: retired [[United States Marine Corps|Marine]] General [[James Mattis]] as [[United States Secretary of Defense|Secretary of Defense]], and retired Marine general [[John F. Kelly]] as [[United States Secretary of Homeland Security|Secretary of Homeland Security]]. [http://www.cnn.com/2017/01/20/politics/senate-trump-cabinet-confirmations/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2016–2017 Gambian constitutional crisis]]
**Lieutenant General [[Ousman Badjie]], chief of the [[Military of the Gambia|Gambian army]], recognizes [[Adama Barrow]] as the new commander-and-chief of the armed forces and says that his troops will not fight [[Economic Community of West African States|ECOWAS]] soldiers. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-gambia-politics-army-idUSKBN154269 (Reuters)]
**[[President of the Gambia|President]] Adama Barrow announces that [[Yahya Jammeh]] has agreed step down and leave the country following an intervention by [[ECOWAS]] states. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-38699119 (BBC)]
